pairing: All unique unordered variant pairs within original explanation, operation, and retained fact count; original excluded; identical fact sets deduplicated. No selector or probe outcome selects variants.
aggregation: Eligible pairs averaged within explanation, explanations within patient, then patients equally. Each pairwise method contrast uses common finite score pairs before aggregation.
endpoint_ties: Excluded from ranking denominator; all possible pairs and tie counts reported. Scorer ties receive 0.5.
secondary_probe: lightgbm; LightGBM-derived scores are self-source descriptive controls
limits: No clinical quality endpoint; support for wrong d is not clinical benefit. No fusion, B4, fit stability, or independent confirmation in this run. R ranks identically to A here. CIs unadjusted; no threshold tuning.
